issues.description: Close message type 'Close' may not match Deepgram's documented 'CloseStream' control message
issues.detail: The PR description and Deepgram docs reference {"type": "CloseStream"}, but _CLOSE_MSG is set to {"type": "Close"}. If Deepgram's TTS WebSocket actually expects 'CloseStream' (as STT does), the server will ignore this and the fix won't work. Verify against Deepgram's Speak v1 socket API before merging.

issues.description: Only awaits a single receive() — may not capture remaining audio frames
issues.detail: asyncio.wait_for(ws.receive(), timeout=1.0) reads exactly one message, then closes. If Deepgram still has buffered audio chunks to flush after Flush+Close, those frames are dropped, which contradicts the PR's stated goal of preventing audio truncation. Should loop until a CloseStream/Closed ack or timeout.

issues.description: send_str on a possibly-closed/closing socket can raise ConnectionResetError
issues.detail: _close_ws may be called during shutdown/error paths where the WebSocket is already closing. send_str will raise, the broad except logs a warning, then ws.close() runs — but the Flush is silently lost. Consider checking ws.closed before sending, so partial flushes happen when possible rather than being swallowed entirely.

issues.description: 1-second hard wait adds latency to every stream teardown
issues.detail: Every TTS stream close now blocks up to 1s waiting for a server message. In high-throughput or rapid-turn agent scenarios this compounds. Consider a shorter timeout (e.g. 250ms) or making it configurable, since the close path is on the hot path for conversational agents.

issues.description: Bare except Exception hides programming errors
issues.detail: The except Exception clause around send/receive will swallow CancelledError-adjacent issues and any AttributeError from a malformed ws. Narrow to (aiohttp.ClientError, asyncio.TimeoutError, ConnectionError) so genuine bugs surface in logs instead of being downgraded to a warning.

issues.description: No test coverage for the new close sequence
issues.detail: This bug fix touches connection teardown — a notoriously fragile area — but ships with no test demonstrating the Flush+Close+ack ordering or the timeout fallback. Even a mock-WebSocket unit test asserting the two send_str calls and the receive() with timeout would lock in the contract.

review.summary: The fix moves Deepgram TTS toward graceful shutdown, but the control-message name ('Close' vs the PR-described 'CloseStream') needs verification against Deepgram's Speak v1 protocol — if wrong, the patch is a no-op. The single-receive() pattern may also drop trailing audio frames, partially defeating the stated purpose. Error handling is overly broad and the 1s blocking wait runs on every stream teardown. No tests accompany a teardown-path change.
